description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Rdelim, which is a plugin for the Smarty template engine. It implements compilation logic for the {rdelim} tag, responsible for outputting the right delimiter in templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Rdelim
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Internal_Compile_Ldelim, responsible for compiling the {rdelim} tag in Smarty templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles PHP code to output the template's right delimiter, utilizing the parent compile method and returning the delimiter value.
